en.t: When winter came, the snow fell with frightening force.

units.source_text: 源氏公子怅望长空，不胜凄凉之感，便取琴来弹，令良清唱歌，惟光吹横笛合奏。

en.t: Prince Genji gazed sadly into the wide sky, unable to bear the desolate feeling, so he took up the koto and played, having Yoshikiyo sing while Koremitsu accompanied them on the transverse flute.

units.source_text: 弹到得心应手、哀艳动人之处，歌声和笛声全都停止，大家举手拭泪了。

en.t: When his playing reached a passage of effortless grace and piercing beauty, the singing and flute both fell silent, and everyone raised a hand to wipe away tears.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起了古昔汉皇遣嫁胡国的王昭君。

en.t: Prince Genji thought of Wang Zhaojun, whom an emperor of Han in ancient times had sent away in marriage to the lands of the Hu.

units.source_text: 设想这女子倘是我自己所爱之人，我将何等悲伤！

en.t: If that woman had been someone I myself loved, how deeply I would have grieved!

units.source_text: 要是这世间我所爱的人被遣放外国，又将如何呢？

en.t: If the person I love in this world were sent away to a foreign land, what would become of me then?

units.source_text: 想到这里，似觉果真会有其事。

en.t: Thinking this far, he felt as though such a thing might truly come to pass.

units.source_text: 便朗诵古人“胡角一声霜后梦”之诗。

en.t: He then recited the old poem: A single note of the Hu horn, a dream after frost.
